# Scenthub

> Scenthub is an independent fragrance discovery library with perfume profiles, notes, accords, houses, comparisons, family trees, affordable-alternative relationships, and interactive scent games.

Canonical site: https://scenthub.se
Language: English

## Primary resources

- [Fragrance catalog](https://scenthub.se/fragrances): Search and filter fragrance profiles by house, accord, rating, popularity, and release year.
- [Fragrance houses](https://scenthub.se/houses): Browse house collections, signature accords, ratings, and release ranges.
- [Compare fragrances](https://scenthub.se/compare): Compare notes, accords, ratings, wear signals, and catalog similarity side by side.
- [Fragrance clones](https://scenthub.se/clones): Sourced affordable-alternative relationships with similarity, price, savings, and community accuracy signals.
- [Fragrance family trees](https://scenthub.se/families): Manually curated fragrance lineages with verification sources.
- [Fragrance trends](https://scenthub.se/trends): Explore how notes, accords, houses, and styles vary across decades.
- [About and methodology](https://scenthub.se/about): Catalog scope, interpretation guidance, curation, source transparency, and limitations.

## Interpretation notes

- Ratings, prices, popularity, wear data, and similarity are approximate catalog signals.
- Coverage varies by fragrance; missing values are shown rather than inferred.
- Clone relationships describe scent inspiration, not product identity or brand affiliation.
- Family pages and clone pages provide source links for their curated or source-specific claims.
- Product names and trademarks belong to their respective owners.
